<set-variable name="assetKind" value="@{
        var apiId = context.Api?.Id ?? string.Empty;
        var toolCsv  = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("contractToolApis", string.Empty);
        var agentCsv = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("contractAgentApis", string.Empty);
        var agents = agentCsv.Split(new[] { ',' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries).Select(s => s.Trim());
        var tools  = toolCsv.Split(new[] { ',' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries).Select(s => s.Trim());
        if (agents.Contains(apiId, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { return "agent"; }
        if (tools.Contains(apiId, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { return "tool"; }
        return "llm";
    }" />
